def main() -> None:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--region", default="us-east-1")
    p.add_argument("--app", default="r6i.xlarge")
    p.add_argument("--gpu", default="g6.xlarge", help="GPU instance type, or none for the CPU-only variant")
    p.add_argument("--db", default="db.t4g.small")
    p.add_argument("--app-disk", type=int, default=80)
    p.add_argument("--gpu-disk", type=int, default=120)
    p.add_argument("--db-disk", type=int, default=20)
    a = p.parse_args()
    loc = LOCATION[a.region]
    ec2 = {"location": loc, "operatingSystem": "Linux", "tenancy": "Shared", "preInstalledSw": "NA", "capacitystatus": "Used"}
    app = price("AmazonEC2", {**ec2, "instanceType": a.app})
    no_gpu = a.gpu.lower() in ("", "none")
    gpu = 0.0 if no_gpu else price("AmazonEC2", {**ec2, "instanceType": a.gpu})
    ips = 1 if no_gpu else 2  # public IPv4 addresses: app EIP (+ GPU VM)
    if no_gpu:
        a.gpu_disk = 0
    db = price("AmazonRDS", {"location": loc, "instanceType": a.db, "databaseEngine": "PostgreSQL", "deploymentOption": "Single-AZ"})
    gp3 = price("AmazonEC2", {"location": loc, "volumeApiName": "gp3", "productFamily": "Storage"})
    rds_gp3 = price("AmazonRDS", {"location": loc, "volumeType": "General Purpose-GP3", "deploymentOption": "Single-AZ", "databaseEngine": "PostgreSQL"})
    ipv4 = 0.005  # USD per public IPv4 address-hour (AWS VPC pricing, Feb 2024)
    secrets = 0.40  # per secret-month
    hourly_compute = app + gpu + db + ips * ipv4
    monthly_storage = gp3 * (a.app_disk + a.gpu_disk) + rds_gp3 * a.db_disk
    rows = {
        "app_vm_per_hour": app, "gpu_vm_per_hour": gpu, "rds_per_hour": db, "public_ipv4_per_hour": ips * ipv4,
        "ebs_gp3_per_gb_month": gp3, "rds_gp3_per_gb_month": rds_gp3,
    }
    est = {
        "running_per_hour": round(hourly_compute, 4),
        "storage_per_month": round(monthly_storage + secrets, 2),
        "8h_demo_day": round(8 * hourly_compute + (monthly_storage + secrets) / 30, 2),
        "24h_day": round(24 * hourly_compute + (monthly_storage + secrets) / 30, 2),
        "workshop_176h_month": round(176 * hourly_compute + monthly_storage + secrets, 2),
        "always_on_730h_month": round(730 * hourly_compute + monthly_storage + secrets, 2),
        "stopped_vms_per_month": round(db * 730 + ips * ipv4 * 730 + monthly_storage + secrets, 2),
    }
    print(json.dumps({"region": a.region, "unit_prices_usd": rows, "estimates_usd": est,
                      "excluded": "data transfer out, CloudWatch beyond free tier, ECR storage (~$0.10/GB-month), S3 (cents), taxes"}, indent=1))

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--env-file", default=str(ROOT / ".env"))
    parser.add_argument("--base-domain", help="cloud: <ip-dashes>.sslip.io; omitted = local ports")
    parser.add_argument("--label", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=900)
    parser.add_argument("--only", nargs="*")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    env = read_env(Path(args.env_file))
    if args.base_domain:
        d = args.base_domain
        urls = {"app": f"https://app.{d}", "mcp": f"https://mcp.{d}/mcp", "langgraph": f"https://studio.{d}", "langfuse": f"https://langfuse.{d}", "grafana": f"https://grafana.{d}"}
        label = args.label or env.get("CLOUD_PROVIDER", "cloud")
    else:
        urls = {"app": "http://localhost:8000", "mcp": "http://localhost:8002/mcp", "langgraph": "http://localhost:8123", "langfuse": "http://localhost:3003", "grafana": "http://localhost:3002"}
        label = args.label or "local"
    smoke = Smoke(urls, env, args.timeout, verify=True)
    checks = [
        ("platform status (all components up)", smoke.platform),
        ("security: auth, roles, SAP write block", smoke.security),
        ("deterministic analytics (readiness, XGBoost, OR-Tools, supplier, quality, logistics, what-if)", smoke.analytics),
        ("RAG semantic search (pgvector + bge-small)", smoke.rag),
        ("operations workspace: insights, role dashboards, product 360, watches, 1-click sandbox execution", smoke.operations_workspace),
        ("LangGraph Server graphs registered", smoke.langgraph_server),
        ("MCP server: initialize, list, call, auth", smoke.mcp),
        ("LangGraph Chat Graph with Qwen tool calls + memory + guardrail", smoke.langgraph_chat),
        ("LangGraph AgentFlow supervisor -> specialist -> interrupt -> review queue", smoke.langgraph_agentflow),
        ("LangGraph Business Graph interrupt -> resume -> review queue", smoke.langgraph_business),
        ("Deep Agent supplier research", smoke.deep_agent),
        ("Flowise Chatflow (Tool Agent + MCP + Qwen)", smoke.flowise_chatflow),
        ("Flowise AgentFlow V2 (supervisor, human input, boundary)", smoke.flowise_agentflow),
        ("manager decision + audit chain", smoke.manager_decision),
        ("observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Langfuse traces)", smoke.observability),
    ]
    for name, fn in checks:
        if args.only and not any(o in name for o in args.only):
            continue
        smoke.check(name, fn)
    passed = sum(r["status"] == "PASS" for r in smoke.results)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    out = ROOT / "deploy-evidence" / f"{label}-smoke-{stamp}.json"
    out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps({"label": label, "urls": urls, "timestamp": stamp, "passed": passed, "total": len(smoke.results), "results": smoke.results}, indent=1, default=str))
    print(f"\n{passed}/{len(smoke.results)} checks passed — evidence: {out}")
    return 0 if passed == len(smoke.results) else 1
